items.meaning: Exact workspace identity, Work Owner, accepted revision, and current artifact identities.
items.absence_behavior: Block command intake; never infer a workspace, owner, or accepted revision.

items.meaning: One typed command or query with actor identity, client identity, request identity, expected revision when mutating, and deadline.
items.absence_behavior: Reject the request without mutation and return a bounded invalid-input outcome.

items.meaning: One purpose-bound context selection with provenance, sufficiency, conflicts, and explicit authority ceiling.
items.absence_behavior: Classify context as insufficient or indeterminate and block dependent work.

items.meaning: For capability-gated or external actions, an exact current grant or one-shot owner decision bound to actor, target, scope, expiry, and revocation state.
items.absence_behavior: Allow read-only or proposal-only work only when its policy permits; otherwise fail closed before dispatch.

owner_routes: Owner of each selected context or grant
challenge_route: Challenge workspace and accepted-state identity through the Work Owner; challenge command and context requirements through the Essays agent-runtime owner; challenge grants through the owner of the exact capability or effect.
claim_limit: This input contract defines admissible command intake; it does not prove input truth, context sufficiency, grant validity, runtime enforcement, or permission for an external effect.
